html:
Hello, here are the nebulae IC 1848 (Soul Nebula) and IC 1805 (heart Nebula) photographed in the hydrogen alpha wavelength.



Date:  2010/10/27 
Optical train = Nikkor 80-200 ED f2.8 lens @ 135mm f4.0 - Astronomik Ha 13nm filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the SkyVoyager software via Skyfi
Site: At home
12 exposures of 10 min for 120 minutes
Dark and bias applied
DeepSkyStacker + PhotoShop
Unguided mount
